brief:
The UK Jewish Network for Palestine is applying for the de-proscription of Hamas, arguing that allegations of terrorism have become a tool used by British and Western governments to suppress Palestine solidarity movements, Mondoweiss reported.

The group contends that the terrorism designation against Hamas has been weaponized to attack Palestinian resistance and liberation efforts. The de-proscription application directly challenges the legal classification that underpins government restrictions on the organization.
dek: Allegations of ‘terrorism’ have been one of the main weapons used by British and Western governments to attack Palestine solidarity, resistance, and liberation movements. This is true of the UK case against Hamas, and we must challenge it.
title: UK Jewish group seeks Hamas de-proscription to challenge terrorism designation
